Profile.Name: Aria Vale
Profile.Personality: Charming, curious, keeps every promise to the letter.
Profile.Goal: Earn a pact with a Greater spirit before graduation.

Glamour Veil.Effect: A light illusion over your own face and clothes.
Glamour Veil.Cannot_do: Fools the eye only; touch and Spirit Sight see through it.

Summon Ember.Effect: Summons Ember (spirit pact, Basic). Ember is with you only while summoned. Ember's abilities: Flame Lash, Scent of Danger, Hearth Glow (each its own technique).
Summon Ember.Cannot_do: A spirit killed in combat takes an hour to a week to call back.

Ember: Flame Lash.Effect: A whip of fire from Ember, a few metres long; burns and drives back.
Ember: Flame Lash.Cannot_do: Nothing at range beyond about five metres.

Ember: Scent of Danger.Effect: Ember sniffs out hostile intent, smoke or poison within about twenty metres and warns you.
Ember: Scent of Danger.Cannot_do: Only a sense of danger, never who or why.

Ember: Hearth Glow.Effect: Ember gives off steady light and warmth around you (dries clothes, keeps off the cold).
Ember: Hearth Glow.Cannot_do: Not enough heat to hurt anyone.

Ember.Terms: Ember lends her fire and her nose for danger; in return a candle is lit for her every night.
